description: Promet na terminskem deviznem trgu po sklenitvi posla is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BANKA SLOVENIJE. This database automatically captures metadata sourced from BANK SLOVENIA and corresponds to the source database entitled "Transport on the foreign exchange futures market after the conclusion of the transaction". The actual data is available in PC-Axis (.px) format. Coverage: BANKA SLOVENIJE. The portal shows the English title as "Turnover on the foreign exchange forward market after the conclusion of the transaction" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is BANKA SLOVENIJE. Its keywords include zunanji zajem PCAXIS. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
